# Atul Jagga

> Speaker, author and CPA (Ontario) and RCIC-IRB based in Toronto. Founder of The Biz Plans, author of Business Plan Essentials and creator of TheBizPlanAI, a free AI business plan generator. 20+ years in finance and strategy.

## Speaking topics
- Funding-ready business plans
- Financial models that hold up
- Pitch decks that get meetings
- Business plans for Canadian immigration (C11, PNP Entrepreneur, Start-Up Visa, Intra-Company Transfer)

## Background
Senior finance roles at Moneris, Payfirma and Vodafone Idea (led an approximately $150 million revenue portfolio). MBA Finance and Strategy (UBC); MBA Marketing and Operations (Panjab University); CFA Level I; CBV Level II. Mentor with Futurpreneur. Languages: English, Hindi, Punjabi.
